## Summary

Describe the change and affected module or reference bundle. Link the issue.

## Validation

List checks run and any remaining validation.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant tests passed; reference changes have reviewed provenance and hashes.
- [ ] Changelog updated, or the reason no entry is needed is stated.
- [ ] Version and dependency changes are consistent, if applicable.
- [ ] Target is `dev`; a release PR targets `main` from `dev` after validation.
